Responsible for developing scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and FastAPI. Focused on code quality, performance optimization, and implementing best practices in software development.
descriptions.taejf: At TAEJF S.A.S. I took over and modernized a mobile project in Flutter backed by Firebase as a Backend-as-a-Service (Auth, Cloud Functions, Remote Config, Firestore and other utilities). I integrated and optimized authentication flows, implemented cloud functions, and developed solutions for remote configuration and observability that improved system stability and maintainability. Additionally, I designed and built complementary applications in Next.js and deployed them to Vercel. I learned the business logic from scratch and proactively resolved technical and product challenges throughout the project.
descriptions.dailybot: Distribution Engineer, focused on developing tools, automations, integrations, open source projects and AI-powered solutions that accelerate product growth and adoption. I operate at the intersection of engineering, product and distribution, creating technical experiments, demos, intelligent workflows and platforms that expand Dailybot's visibility, optimize processes and generate growth opportunities at scale.

about.bioLead: An engineer from Dosquebradas: I write software someone else can pick up, and I host rooms where people learn out loud.

bio.p1: Friends call me Barto. I was born in Manizales, have lived in Dosquebradas since 2009, and finished Systems and Computing Engineering at UTP in 2025. Campus left me a better habit than a diploma: asking whether what we ship survives real use, not just the demo.
bio.p2: Day to day I move between Flutter apps, Firebase or FastAPI backends, and TypeScript fronts. I would rather leave tests, pipelines, and decisions that do not depend on me being in the chat than collect frameworks. If a deploy or an API can be understood without guessing, the work is done.
bio.p3: Since 2023 I have been pushing the tech calendar in Colombia's Coffee Axis: logistics, speakers, and the conversation after the talk. Founding QAConf — the region's first gathering built around software quality — is the part of the job that does not fit in a repository.

about.timelineLead: Throughout my career I have contributed to commercial, academic, and community projects, taking on responsibilities that range from development and testing to deployment, continuous improvement, and team support.
